versions.content: If FrNmPnEraCalcEnabled is TRUE and the stored value for a PN changes to requested or back to not requested (see SWS_FrNm_00434 and SWS_FrNm_00437) FrNm shall inform the upper layers by calling PduR_FrNmRxIndication() for the configured ERA PDU (i.e. changed ERA information shall be passed to COM).

If FrNmPnEraCalcEnabled is TRUE and the stored value for a PN changes to requested or back to not requested (see SWS_FrNm_00434 and SWS_FrNm_00437) FrNm shall inform the upper layers by calling PduR_FrNmRxIndication() for the configured ERA PDU (i.e. changed ERA information shall be passed to COM).
